paper_title: Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners A Comprehensive   Evaluation and Beyond
caption: Visualization on the metric of answer correctness.
model_annotation: This three-dimensional bar chart visualizes the correctness of answers across different language models and reasoning types. The horizontal axis represents the language models, labeled as Davinci-003, ChatGPT, BARD, and Mix, with the arrangement appearing to be in alphabetical order. The vertical axis depicts the reasoning types, labeled as Deductive, Inductive, and Abductive, presented in that order from left to right. The third dimension, extending into the plane of the chart, represents the accuracy, labeled as "Accuracy" on the left vertical axis, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, and the tick labels are at increments of 0.2. Each language model/reasoning type combination is represented by a rectangular prism, with varying heights and depths, colored in a gradient from blue to yellow. The shortest prism, at the intersection of Davinci-003 and Deductive reasoning, has an approximate height corresponding to a value of 0.2, while the tallest prism, at the intersection of Mix and Inductive reasoning, reaches approximately 0.8. The prisms are oriented along the horizontal and vertical axes, showing a range of values, and no particular bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or annotations.
